name: fix-table-merge-picker
title: Fix table merge picker opening
description: Use a stable delegated trigger for the existing searchable table picker so the current React button always opens same-floor table selection.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The failed pointer/focus patch was removed. The final fix reuses the existing picker and mutation, labels the action Chọn bàn, rebinds replaced React buttons, and delegates the first click from a stable document boundary. No schema, resolver, permission, audit-log, dependency, or business-rule change. A focused regression test was added; no local test/build or CI workflow ran in the connected environment.
